title: Senior Associate Technical Services Cross Technology Systems Integration Specialist
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Senior Associate Cross Technology Technical Services (TS) Systems Integration Specialist is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for ensuring that client solution requirements are resolved in line with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).  
  
This role performs configurations, actions installations and attends to break/fix events and works towards associate to professional level certification, whilst at the same time developing business knowledge.  
  
This role is developing proficiency across two or more technologies, namely Networking, Data Centre, Security, Customer experience, Collaboration and/or End User Compute.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Owns larger portions of an installation, break/fix incidents at a low to medium level of complexity during project lifecycle.
* Takes responsibility for problem resolution and troubleshooting during project lifecycle.
* Escalates complex problems to the relevant third parties.
* Assists with the documentation of standard operating procedures relating to installations and fixes during ops handover.
* Compiles and maintain project administration (Time Capture and feedback to stakeholders).
* Conducts elementary presentations within the customer's organization.
* Expected to take leadership from senior resources on relevant technologies according to specialization and best practice.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Developing understanding and appreciation of technical design and business principles.
* Developing knowledge of fundamental project and administration ability.
* Displays customer engagement skills.
* Demonstrate. relevant domain specialist knowledge.
* Good verbal communication skills.
* Client focused and display a proactive approach to solving problems.
* Ability to work under pressure.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Computing or a related field.
* Collaboration -
* Valid CCNP Collaboration certification required (Voice certification preferred)
* Customer experience -
* NICE plus one additional NICE Engage NCSE and / or NICE Engage NCIE; Sentinel Fundamentals; CXOne Basic Certification; CXOne Advanced Certification; CXOne ACD Administrator Certification.
* Additional -
* Nexidia Data exchange framework; Nexidia NCSE; Nexidia NCIE; Advanced Processing Automation (RTAM); NICE WFM (IEX); Compliance Centre; NICE Inform Avaya VOIP Integrations; Cisco VOIP Integrations.
* Encryption; Multiple Data Centers (MDC); NICE Real Time Authentication; NICE Trade Recording.
* Avaya plus one or two additional Avaya Aura Core; Avaya Aura Contact Centre; Avaya IP Office; Avaya IP Office Contact Centre; Avaya Session Border Controller; Avaya experience Portal Administration
* Verint including Workforce Management (WFM); Interactions; Speech
* Genesys foundational courses - Genesys Cloud CX - Implementation; Genesys Cloud CX - Contact Centre Administration; Genesys Cloud CX - Reporting and Analytics
* Genesys level 2 - Genesys Cloud CX - Architect (ILT); Genesys Cloud CX - Quality Management (ILT); Genesys Cloud CX - Scripting (ILT); Genesys Cloud CX - Outbound (ILT); Genesys Cloud - Web Chat; Genesys Cloud - Web Messaging; Genesys Cloud - Agentless Voice Notifications; Introduction to Genesys Cloud for Supervisors - Advanced Management
* Data Center -
* Relevant certifications such as HPE Proliant servers, 3PAR, Primera, Alletra, Simplicity, MSA Storage; Dell PowerEdge servers, Unity, PowerStore; VMware Certified Associate VCTA-DVC; Dell Information Storage Associate - DCA-ISM; Veeam Backup and Recovery and or Veritas Netbackup; Azure Fundamentals.
* End User Compute -
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified Professional; Microsoft 365 Administrator (MS-100, MS-101); Microsoft 365 Certified - Modern Desktop Administrator Associate (MD-100, MD-101); Microsoft Azure Fundamentals Training & Certification (AZ-900); Microsoft 365 Certified; Teams Administrator Associate; Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate; Server 2016.
* Networking -
* Professional level certification in different Networking technologies such as Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, F5, CCNP, JNCIP, ACMP etc.
* Security -
* Azure Certified Security Engineer / PCNSA / FCA / CCNA Security; Cloud Security certifications and certifications such as AZ-500, SC-200, Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM or similar certification in different networking technologies such as CCDP /CCNP Security, JNCIA, ACCA, PCNSE, PCNSA, FCP, CCSA, ITIL, Azure Security Engineer, Azure Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure Certified Network Engineer, Azure Administrator Associate, is advantageous.
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage) - Terraform; Azure; Sentinel; EDR Defender for Cloud; Microsoft Security; Devops Ci/CD Pipelins; Azure Governance (Defender for Cloud, Azure Policies, Secure Score and Compliance); Version Control (Git); Microservices (Kubernetes, Azure Containers); Azure / AWS/ GCP Infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS); Azure Infrastructure as Code; Azure Administration; Hybrid Cloud Networking (Firewalls, LAN, VPN); Automation; MS Office365; Power BI Administration; Scripting (PowerShell); ZTNA.

**Required experience:**

* Moderate level of experience in a technical implementation engineering technologies such as Networking, Data Centre, Security, Customer experience, Collaboration and/or End User Compute etc.
* Moderate level of experience engaging with clients and conducting presentations.

title: Delivery & Release Coordinator (UAT and Quality) - IFS Logistics
description:
**Company Description**

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**

**About IFS Logistics**

IFS Logistics is an AI enterprise logistics platform that helps shippers and logistics businesses connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. Originally launched as 7bridges, the product is now part of IFS and is developed by a small, dedicated team.

**The role**

We are looking for a Delivery & Release Coordinator to manage user acceptance testing, release activity and day-to-day delivery coordination across the product team.

The team is preparing for its first IFS Cloud customer go-live, bringing a new API into production and recruiting a significant number of new colleagues. As the pace of delivery increases, we need clear ownership of test cycles, defects, release readiness and communication.

You will coordinate UAT with customers and internal stakeholders, maintain release plans and checklists, track defects through to resolution and support go/no-go decisions. You will work closely with Lorraine Hassall, our Quality Manager, allowing her to focus on quality standards and strategy while you manage the practical coordination required to apply them consistently.

Most of the role is focused on UAT, releases and delivery. It also includes a smaller amount of team coordination, particularly onboarding, in-person sessions, travel planning, and financial coordination.

**What you'll work on**

**UAT and release management**

* Plan and coordinate UAT cycles with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Confirm scope, participants, test windows, evidence and sign-off for each cycle.
* Track defects from identification through triage, ownership, resolution and closure.
* Support on the release calendar, release notes, readiness checklist and go/no-go process.
* Coordinate with other teams in IFS as the product is integrated with IFS Cloud.
* Support the UAT and release plan for Project Oliver and the first IFS Cloud customer go-live.

**Supporting the quality function**

* Work with the Quality Manager on test processes, evidence and audit trails.
* Help apply standards such as clear acceptance criteria, merge-request review and controlled production releases.
* Support the move from periodic manual QA towards per-ticket quality assurance and more frequent releases.

**Delivery coordination**

* Keep Jira accurate, with current statuses, acceptance criteria and links to relevant merge requests.
* Maintain useful documentation and decision records in Notion.
* Prepare concise delivery and release updates for product and engineering leads.
* Identify risks early, clarify ownership and follow actions through to completion.

**Team coordination**

* Organise onboarding logistics for new starters and monthly in-person sessions in Staines.
* Coordinate team travel, expenses and purchase orders.

 **Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Strong organisation and follow-through, with a habit of identifying and addressing issues early.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* The ability to work constructively with engineers and maintain agreed standards when priorities are competing.
* A practical, accountable approach to moving work forward without waiting for detailed direction.
* Experience coordinating UAT, software releases or delivery within a product or engineering team.
* Familiarity with release notes, test cycles, defect tracking, go/no-go decisions, acceptance criteria and regression scope.
* Experience managing a defect list through triage and resolution rather than only reporting its status.
* Confidence using Jira and a documentation platform such as Notion or Confluence.

Relevant backgrounds may include delivery coordination, release coordination, junior delivery management, QA coordination, scrum mastery or project coordination. We are more interested in what you have managed than in your previous job title.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with enterprise software involving customer UAT and formal sign-off.
* Exposure to regulated or audited environments, ERP products or supply-chain software.
* ISTQB, Agile or delivery certification.
* Experience working within a large organisation with established procurement and HR processes.
* Experience using AI tools to draft release notes, summarise defect lists or prepare status updates.

**Tools**

The team uses Jira, Notion, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, along with IFS systems for travel, expenses and purchasing. You do not need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with engineers and understanding their delivery processes.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* Releases follow a predictable cadence and include clear, accurate release notes.
* Each UAT cycle has an agreed owner, schedule, defect list, evidence and sign-off.
* Customer and support defects receive clear ownership and a visible route to resolution.
* The Project Oliver go-live is supported by a well-managed UAT and release plan.
* Acceptance criteria, review and release controls are applied consistently.
* Product and engineering leads spend less time on routine coordination and administration.

**Why we're hiring now**

The product team is growing and preparing for several important releases. The Quality Manager currently carries much of the practical coordination associated with testing and releases. This role will provide dedicated support of that work, helping the team increase delivery frequency while maintaining clear quality and release controls.

 **Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Sr Service Support Coordinator
description:
Overview:

Join a dynamic and customer-focused service organization where you will play a critical role in ensuring seamless coordination of field service activities and delivering an exceptional customer experience. As a Service Coordinator, you will work closely with customers, field engineers, and cross-functional teams to manage service operations, drive efficiency, and support the successful execution of service commitments. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your organizational skills, problem-solving mindset, and ability to build strong relationships will directly contribute to customer success and operational excellence.

  
Responsibilities:

* Monitor service orders from initiation through completion, proactively identifying and resolving scheduling, logistics, or operational issues to minimize delays and improve service performance.
* Collaborate with field engineers, service managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure efficient execution of service commitments and adherence to operational processes.
* Maintain accurate service records, documentation, and system updates, ensuring data integrity and providing visibility into service performance.
* Track key service metrics and generate reports to support operational reviews, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous process optimization.
* Support business objectives by ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and quality requirements while contributing to a culture of operational excellence and teamwork.

  
Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree with 3-5+ years of experience in service coordination, field service operations, customer support, scheduling or a related operational role within a service-driven organization.  
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple service requests, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with customers, field service engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.  
Proficiency in ERP, CRM, and service management systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceMax, or similar tools), along with strong Microsoft Office skills.  
Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a proactive approach to resolving scheduling, logistics, and customer service challenges.  
Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail, data accuracy, teamwork, and a commitment to delivering high-quality service and operational excellence.

Company Description:

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of ~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.

*Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.*

title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
On a daily basis, Business Coaches are responsible for:  
  
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.  
  
A day in the life  
As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. Together, you’ll provide best-in-class support for owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
